name: thumbs_up_hand
positive: A minimalist flat vector icon of thumbs up hand: a closed fist with the thumb pointing upward, Minimalist flat vector icon on a pure white background. Preserve the subject's recognizable shape, proportions, orientation, and essential features. Simplify its appearance into a few large, smooth, rounded solid shapes while keeping the subject clearly identifiable. Create a clean, playful, modern pictogram with soft organic curves, simplified geometry, and minimal visual complexity. Center the complete subject on a 1:1 square canvas, occupying approximately 30% of the image area, with generous white space on all sides. No outlines, gradients, shadows, textures, realistic details, 3D effects, text, logos, frames, decorative elements, or additional objects. The final result should be a small, recognizable, professionally designed minimalist microstock icon, not a detailed illustration or realistic rendering.
